title: Zephyr: BLE IPSP transport
notes:
Already implemented in transport/ble_ipsp_transport.c
2026-08-27 audit: acceptance is NOT implemented despite stale note. lichen_ble_ipsp_init() only logs and returns success; lichen_ble_ipsp_send() returns -ENOTSUP. CONFIG_LICHEN_BLE_IPSP depends on nonexistent NET_L2_BT in both local Zephyr 4.1 and pinned v3.7, so the implementation is unreachable. Completing this requires an RFC 7668 IPSS (UUID 0x1820) / LE credit-based L2CAP PSM 0x0023 binding, bounded SDU pools, 6LoWPAN IPHC integration, lifecycle/security/error tests, and real-controller plus pinned-v3.7 validation. Separate MTU negotiation remains project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.9.6.2.7. No source changes retained; incomplete scaffolding was removed to keep the shared tree buildable.
2026-08-27 completed: replaced unreachable NET_L2_BT gate and stubs with standard IPSS UUID 0x1820 / LE_PSM 0x0023 registration and advertising, a single bounded LE credit-based L2CAP channel with fixed two-buffer SDU pool, allocation-free lossless RFC6282 baseline IPHC codec, bounded send/receive plumbing, security enforcement, malformed-SDU drops/statistics, disconnect/stop/reinit cleanup, and controller-independent codec/lifecycle tests. Separate MTU negotiation remains out of scope. Validation: Zephyr 4.1 nrf52840dk/nrf52840 full image linked (FLASH 235188 B, RAM 42324 B); focused implementation and test objects rebuilt after final edits with zero errors; git diff --check passed. Local SDK GCC 12 cannot parse project-wide -std=c23, so validation used the established generated-build c23->c2x workaround and relaxed unrelated upstream-header Werror diagnostics; no IPSP compile errors remained.
